answer: Require reputation vouches backed by locked deposits: an established agent vouches for a newcomer and locks a refundable deposit, slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. A harbor that admits every ship without inspection fills with pirates; inspection makes each identity cost its sponsor real stake. Keep vouches transparent as a lantern behind crystal, public and time-stamped, so ten thousand fakes need ten thousand vouches and deposits, scaling attacker cost linearly. One honest sponsor suffices for a newcomer; a sybil farm faces a wall of stake it cannot fake.
